tax_litigation.status: The Hon’ble Rajasthan High Court ruled against the Company in the matter of electricity duty on captive solar power consumption. The Company filed SLP (Civil) No. 28095 of 2026 before the Hon’ble Supreme Court on 26 June 2026, which is pending. AVVNL subsequently raised a demand of ₹11.42 crore, including LPS, for five locations. Pursuant to AVVNL’s permission, the Company deposited ₹7.42 crore under protest with the Commercial Taxes Department. The estimated liability for Banswara units is ₹6.83 crore, taking the total identified and estimated liability to ₹14.25 crore. subject to the outcome of the judicial proceedings.

holders.name: FINQUEST SECURITIES PRIVATE LIMITED - PROPRIETARY ACCOUNT

timeline.summary: Board approved Q1FY27 results and a JV for a ₹186.30 Cr denim garment unit with NDS9 Private Limited.
RSWM reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹1,161 Cr, EBITDA of ₹94 Cr, and PAT of ₹17 Cr, citing operational excellence and improved product mix.
2026-08-11: RSWM announces a joint venture with Spain's NDS9 to establish a ₹186.30 Cr denim garment manufacturing facility in India.
2026-08-14: Income Tax officials visited RSWM corporate office on August 10, 2026, and completed their checking on August 13, 2026
On 2026-08-21, RSWM incorporated the joint venture company LNJ NDS9 Global Private Limited for the denim garment project with NDS9.
RSWM Limited’s 65th AGM on August 26, 2026, passed all six resolutions with full shareholder approval via e-voting and postal ballots, including financial statements and director re-appointment.
2026-10-16: RSWM released FY25-26 sustainability report showing 40.5% reduction in Scope 1 emissions

watchlist.text: Term lender approvals for 70% debt funding
